title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final thickness of the soap film must be correctly calculated as d = 4260 Å.

title: Optical Path Difference
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the optical path difference must be correctly derived as Δ = 2nd cos θ + λ/2.

title: Constructive Interference Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition for constructive interference must be correctly stated as Δ = 2λ.

title: Snell's Law Application
description: Important Criteria: Snell's law must be correctly applied to find the angle of refraction inside the film.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used throughout the calculations must be consistent and correctly converted.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the optical path difference calculation will lead to a deduction.

title: Angle Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The calculation of cos θ must be correctly derived from the angle of refraction.
